name: DocsArticle
title: Templates/Docs/Article
summary: A whole documentation article page, chrome included: the docs bar with a `SearchTrigger` that widens into the ⌘K field, the product rail (`Sidebar` + `MenuRoot`, a folding group for the current section, the `ThemeSwitcher` in its footer), the reading column and the “On this page” rail with the closing `DocCta`. Under the masthead the column is one `DocProse` (which gives `DocHeading` its scale) built only from the documentation parts, in reading order: `DocPageHeader` (breadcrumb, title, deck, last updated, Copy / View as Markdown, Agent setup), `DocProse` for running text, a `DocCardGroup` chooser of paths, `DocCallout` tips and notes, `DocHeading` sections that the outline links to, `DocSteps` with `CodeBlock` commands, a `DocPrompt` for the coding agent, Next steps as `DocCardGroup`, Related resources as `DocItem` rows in a `FrameBox`, and `DocPagination`. The primary state is a tutorial (First deploy); the Reference variant is a product reference page (an info callout, the request path as a `Diagram` in a `DocFrame`, a JSON `CodeBlock` and a term list). Built from `GlobalHeader`, `NavigationMenu`, `SearchTrigger`, `Sidebar`, `MenuRoot`, `ThemeSwitcher`, `ScrollArea`, the `Doc*` parts, `CodeBlock`, `Footer` and `StatusIndicator`.
intents: docs page with steps and code
